title: The Digital Footprint: Your Reputation Is Being Built Now and Read in 10 Years
summary: Every post, comment, like, and search is stored, analyzed, sold, and remains. Universities, companies, and governments examine the digital footprint. The rule: "Do not post what you would not want your future father, future manager, or future spouse to see." Monthly review: delete the old, fix privacy settings, and clean the trail.
try_this: This week: log into your child’s accounts together—review old posts, location tags, and apps with granted permissions. Delete or fix them together.
reflection_prompts: How many posts were deleted or hidden?
Did your child understand the concept of a "permanent footprint"?

review_defects.arabic: لا تنشر ما لا تريد أن يراه والدك/مديرك المستقبلي/زوجك المستقبلي
review_defects.english: Do not post what you would not want your future father, future manager, or future spouse to see.
review_defects.why: The Arabic specifies 'والدك' (your father) without 'المستقبلي' (future), but the English adds 'future' to father, incorrectly implying the father is a future figure rather than a current one.
